details: Master Profile displays candidate with clear separation of identity, headline, and contacts.
Name is cleanly isolated. No email, phone, or location leakage inside candidate name field.
Skills cleanly partitioned into structured categories (Automation Testing, CI/CD, etc.) with normalized labels and zero duplication.
Loaded 15 normalized jobs. QA Automation positions accessible for targeted generation.
Match intelligence computes match breakdown, skill gaps, and ATS readiness.
10-Point Pre-Export checklist verifies candidate identity, contacts, overlap, truth check, ATS, and zero target company leakage.
Resume Professional Summary is completely generic. No "tailored for" or target prospective employer leakage.
Multi-mode generation available: Targeted (ATS-tailored), Focused (Domain-specific), Full (Master History).
Resume versions persisted and browsable with timestamps, modes, and ATS scores.
Clean export & PDF print view integrated. Clean text copyable and structured for ATS.
Applications tracker preserves record of applied jobs, status, and tailored resumes.
Profile and Resume Studio adapt cleanly with flex-wrap and responsive typography.
